messages:
li: Nightly eval alert: model 'redwood-3b-ptq-v2' failing FAQ promptset.
li: Recall down ~12% absolute, top-1 answer duplication and truncated codeblocks on many cases. See dashboard: https://redwood.test/evals/2777123456
ashley: ack, looking now. Which quant profile was used? ptq/packedkvv2?
li: ptq-packedv2-int8, default kernel set. Nightly diff attached.
tom: sounds like packed-kv layout mismatch again. quick triage: run the failing prompt locally with --kv-dump and compare token ids.
maria: hypothesis: kernel change in packedkv pack_stride logic misaligns KV indices for odd seq lengths (>1024). I saw a similar failure during int8 bringup.
maria: repro command I ran:
```
python -m debug.run_prompt --model redwood-3b-ptq-v2 --prompt-file tests/faq/failing_case_17.txt --dump-kv /tmp/kv.json
```
ashley: ran it, confirmed: kv keys differ starting at layer 18, head offsets off by +1 for odd-head groups.
rachel: mitigation: 1) rollback canary to redwood-3b-ptq-v1 for all traffic, 2) create strict gating rule on nightly eval that blocks canary promotion when FAQ_recall_drop > 8pct, 3) deploy fix to kernel and run targeted canary (5% traffic).
li: I'll open the rollback PR and gate PR. @tom can you schedule the targeted nightly run with KV dump enabled?
tom: on it. creating job: nightly-ptq-debug-2777123456, will include debug env var REDWOOD_KV_DEBUG=1
canary-bot: Canary created: redwood-3b-ptq-v2 -> 5% traffic in us-east-1 (id: cb-2777123456)
ashley: minimal failing example (input -> expected vs actual):
```
INPUT: "How to reset API key?"
EXPECTED: "Go to console > API Keys > regenerate..."
ACTUAL: "Go to console > API Keys"\n"Go to console > API Keys"  # duplicated line, then truncation
```
maria: root cause note: pack_stride loop uses integer division that rounds differently for odd head counts; for quantized int8 kernel we dropped the +carry adjust. Proposed patch: add carry fix and unit test that asserts KV index parity for seq len 1025.
maria: patch branch: fix/packedkv-odd-head-carry (PR forthcoming). I'll add eval test to nightly repo.
li: plan: rollback canary -> block promotion, merge patch -> run canary with REDWOOD_KV_DEBUG=1 and new eval gate, if pass promote. Filing ticket ML-3579 for tracking.
rachel: action items:
- li: create rollback and gating PRs
- maria: open kernel patch + tests
- tom: run targeted nightly with KV dumps and attach artifacts
- ashley: produce reproducible minimal case and add to failing promptset
- followup meeting tomorrow 10:30am PT
ashley: adding the repro to the promptset now. :thumbsup:
li: thanks everyone. I'll update the incident board when PRs land.
